name: Greece

outcome.certified: After studying this section, a candidate will know the location, climate, and grape varieties of three important wine regions of Greece. Certified Sommeliers will recognize iconic producers and be able to recommend and sell food pairings with wines from Greece to a guest.

rows.certified: Greece is located in Southern Europe between the Aegean Sea and the Ionian Sea.
Santorini PDO; Naoussa PDO; Nemea PDO
Santorini PDO: Warm Mediterranean; Naoussa PDO: Continental
Santorini: Located in the Aegean Sea, salt air influence
Santorini: Grapes are grown in the shape of baskets to protect them from intense Aegean winds.
Naoussa PDO: Xinomavro; Nemea PDO: Agiorgitiko

Santorini Assyrtiko is a classic white wine with intense acidity and minerality. Pairs well with seafood, roasted fish and fresh cheeses.; Naoussa Xinomavro: Bold red wine that is often oak aged. Needs meat or animal fat such as lamb and beef to pair well to tame the rich tannins.
